{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 141,
      "where": "Remarque 2.4, determination of quasi-coherent modules",
      "scan": "Modules quasi-cohérents sur X",
      "tex": "Modules quasi-cohérents\nsur $X$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "Modules quasi-cohérents sur $Z$",
      "note": "The gluing scheme is Z; X is only one of its two closed pieces. The TeX retains the printed X."
    },
    {
      "page": 141,
      "where": "Remarque 2.4, parenthetical formula defining X",
      "scan": "$X=V(\\mathfrak{J})$",
      "tex": "$X=V(\\mathfrak{F})$",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "X=V(\\mathfrak{F})",
        "new": "X=V(\\mathfrak{J})"
      },
      "note": "The printed Gothic letter is J, also used in the following intersection condition, not F."
    },
    {
      "page": 141,
      "where": "Remarque 2.4, the two occurrences of K in the final parenthesis",
      "scan": "$Y=V(\\underline{K})$, $J\\cap \\underline{K}=0$",
      "tex": "$Y=V(\\bar{K})$, $J\\cap \\bar{K}=0$",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$Y=V(\\bar{K})$, $J\\cap \\bar{K}=0$",
        "new": "$Y=V(\\underline{K})$, $J\\cap \\underline{K}=0$"
      },
      "note": "Both strokes are below K, in the typescript's sheaf notation, not overbars. This is mathematical notation rather than emphasis."
    },
    {
      "page": 142,
      "where": "Proposition 3.1(i), support condition",
      "scan": "supp(D₀ ne rencontre pas Z₀",
      "tex": "$\\supp$ ($D_{\\circ}$ ne rencontre\npas $Z_{\\circ}$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$\\supp(D_{\\circ})$ ne rencontre pas $Z_{\\circ}$",
      "note": "The closing parenthesis after D₀ is missing in the print. The TeX keeps the omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 142,
      "where": "Proposition 3.1(ii), parenthetical sufficient condition",
      "scan": "condition automatiquement satisfaite X est noethérien et si X₀ admet",
      "tex": "condition automatiquement satisfaite $X$ est noethérien et\nsi $X_{\\circ}$ admet",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "condition automatiquement satisfaite si $X$ est noethérien et si $X_{\\circ}$ admet",
      "note": "The print omits «si» before X. The TeX retains this omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 142,
      "where": "Proof of Proposition 3.1(i), local equation f_x",
      "scan": "$f_x\\in\\rad(\\Oo_{X_{\\circ}},x)$",
      "tex": "$f_x\\in \\rad$ ($\\Oo_{X_{\\circ}},x$)",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$f_x\\in\\rad(\\Oo_{X_{\\circ},x})$",
      "note": "The x belongs in the local-ring subscript. The print places it outside that subscript, and the TeX keeps this reading."
    },
    {
      "page": 142,
      "where": "Proof of Proposition 3.1(i), empty-set sign; recurring convention",
      "scan": "$V(g_x)\\cap\\Ass \\Oo_{U_x}=\\emptyset$",
      "tex": "$V(g_x)\\cap\\Ass \\Oo_{U_x}=\\phi$",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "V(g_x)\\cap\\Ass \\Oo_{U_x}=\\phi",
        "new": "V(g_x)\\cap\\Ass \\Oo_{U_x}=\\emptyset"
      },
      "note": "The printed sign is the slashed empty-set circle, not Greek phi. This substitution recurs on p. 143; the coordinator gives its scope and three examples."
    },
    {
      "page": 142,
      "where": "Proof of Proposition 3.1(i), «Mais pour s»",
      "scan": "$s\\in\\Ass \\Oo_X$ du deuxième type",
      "tex": "$s\\in \\Ass\n\\Oo_{X}$ du deuxième type",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$z\\in\\Ass \\Oo_{X}$ du deuxième type",
      "note": "The associated point under discussion is z throughout the surrounding argument. The print has s here, and the TeX keeps it."
    },
    {
      "page": 143,
      "where": "Proof of Proposition 3.1(i), definition of T_x",
      "scan": "$T_x=Y'_n-Y'_x\\cap U_x$",
      "tex": "$T_x=Y'_n-Y'_x\\cap U_x$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$T_x=Y'_x-Y'_x\\cap U_x$",
      "note": "The printed subscript n should be x, referring to the connected component just constructed. The TeX keeps n."
    },
    {
      "page": 143,
      "where": "Proof of Proposition 3.1(i), sum defining D",
      "scan": "$D=\\sum_x d'_x$",
      "tex": "$D=\\Sigma_x\nd'_x$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$D=\\Sigma_x D'_x$",
      "note": "The summands are the Cartier divisors D'_x just introduced; lowercase d'_x is undefined. The TeX retains the printed lowercase d."
    },
    {
      "page": 143,
      "where": "Proof of Proposition 3.1(ii), «signifie en effet que pour»",
      "scan": "que pour L₀ admet une section",
      "tex": "que pour\n$\\LL_{\\circ}$ admet une section",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "que $\\LL_{\\circ}$ admet une section",
      "note": "The word «pour» is superfluous in the print. The TeX keeps it."
    },
    {
      "page": 143,
      "where": "Introduction to Corollaire 3.2, reference after «la démonstration de»",
      "scan": "5.1 (iii)",
      "tex": "\\hyperrefext[XII][XII.thm5.1]{5.1} (iii)",
      "kind": "number",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\hyperrefext[XII][XII.thm5.1]{5.1}",
        "new": "\\hyperref[XII.thm5.1]{5.1}"
      },
      "note": "The print does not repeat XII after the preceding reference to XII 8.6. The external-reference macro adds that numeral."
    },
    {
      "page": 144,
      "where": "Corollaire 3.2, target of the canonical Picard map",
      "scan": "$\\Pic(X)\\rightarrow\\Pic(X_{\\circ})$",
      "tex": "$\\Pic(X)\\rightarrow \\Pic(X_{\\circ})$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$\\Pic(X)\\rightarrow\\Pic(X'_{\\circ})$",
      "note": "The conclusion must concern the arbitrary closed subscheme X'₀ quantified in the statement; the proof applies the proposition to (X,X'₀). The TeX retains the print's missing prime."
    },
    {
      "page": 144,
      "where": "Proof of Corollaire 3.2, opening sentence",
      "scan": "on applique la proposition",
      "tex": "on applique le proposition",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "le proposition",
        "new": "la proposition"
      },
      "note": "The print has «la», not «le»."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "141: 2/1; 142: 1/4; 143: 1/3; 144: 1/1 (normal/misprint; recurring convention counted once).\nConvention: replace all four occurrences of \\phi on pp. 142–143 by \\emptyset. Three examples: p. 142, V(g_x)\\cap\\Ass \\Oo_{U_x}; p. 143, V(g_x)\\cap\\Ass \\Oo_{U_x}; p. 143, T_x\\cap X_{\\circ}."
}
